intent.subtype: writer count set by a parameter
intent.rationale: Writers are generated per lane; with NUM_WR=1 (default) there is one, an override gives several.

labels.note: The generate loop creates one memory writer per lane; a single writer at the default NUM_WR=1, several for any larger override.
With the default NUM_WR=1 there is one writer, but any NUM_WR>1 (the stated purpose) makes several processes write the same memory.

settlement.note: With the default NUM_WR=1 the generate loop creates exactly one clocked writer of mem; several writers appear only under a parameter override, which is not this configuration.
